I am renting this small plot of wheat, only a quarter of a timad really, so I must be careful with every birr I spend. I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative like most of us in Tigray do for wheat, but not too much because the land is rented and the rains have been uncertain. I cannot afford improved seed this year, so I will use seed I saved and some from my neighbor. My children and I will do most of the work ourselves; I will only hire a man with oxen for the ploughing since I have none of my own.
